title: Polytomic Sync Freshness SLA
app: Polytomic sync run events via the Polytomic API/webhooks to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=polytomic:sync status="completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by sync_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>6
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Polytomic sync and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A sync can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Polytomic.
implementation: Ingest Polytomic success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical sync exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of sync by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Polytomic has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
